result.summary: Found 3 issues: major content truncation problems where restaurant names and cards are cut off at screen edges, affecting content readability and usability.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right side, with the full restaurant name and image truncated
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards fit properly within the viewport width or implement proper horizontal scrolling that fully displays each card without cutting content

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be truncated - should likely be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar, making it unclear to users
issues.suggestion: Verify the complete restaurant name and ensure text truncation doesn't occur with CSS text-overflow properties or by adjusting card width

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off - the restaurant name and details below the image are not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper spacing and height for cards to display all content, or implement pagination/scrolling to show complete information

issues.description: Category filter pills at the top appear to extend beyond the visible viewport, suggesting there are more categories that aren't fully accessible
issues.suggestion: Make the category filter section horizontally scrollable with proper indicators, or adjust layout to show all relevant categories
